svg.title: Disassembly of def swap(a, b): return a * b on three CPython versions: 5 instructions on 3.12.13, 4 on 3.13.14 and 3.14.6. Below, three source constructs and the opcode each version uses.

text.tspan: The same source, three CPython versions
def swap(a, b): return a * b
Amber boxes: the instructions that change between versions. Each is a real opcode on its version;
none of them is wrong. Opcode names are not a stable interface (dis docs).
